name: open-elevated-deck-drops-steeply-after-split
open: Splitting an elevated dead-end road leaves the deck flat at 14.3 for 3.75 units past the new node and then dropping 5 units in 4 (124 %) before settling at 16 %: continuous but kinked, far past the grade limit. In world/elevation.ts (node plate reach versus the leg's own descent to its free end); not attempted for lack of budget.
